properties.entry: SELECT c.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID AS CLIENT_ID, m.CLE_CLIENT_NAME AS CLIENT_NAME_EN, m.CLA_CLIENT_NAME AS CLIENT_NAME_AR, c.CL_CLIENT_ID AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, c.CLE_CLIENT_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME, c.CUR_CODE AS BASE_CURRENCY FROM INSIGHT.CB_CLIENT c JOIN INSIGHT.CB_MAIN_CLIENT m ON m.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID = c.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID WHERE c.CL_CLIENT_ID = :accountNumber
SELECT SWEEP_NO, SWEEP_DATE, CLIENT_ID, AMT FROM INSIGHT.SWEEP_FACILITY WHERE SWEEP_TYPE = :type AND SWEEP_DATE >= :fromDate AND SWEEP_DATE < :toDateExclusive ORDER BY SWEEP_DATE, SWEEP_NO
SELECT SWEEP_NO, SWEEP_DATE, CLIENT_ID, AMT FROM INSIGHT.SWEEP_FACILITY WHERE SWEEP_TYPE = :type AND SWEEP_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND SWEEP_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 ORDER BY SWEEP_DATE, SWEEP_NO
SELECT SWEEP_NO, SWEEP_TYPE FROM INSIGHT.SWEEP_FACILITY WHERE SWEEP_NO IN (:sweepNos) FOR UPDATE
UPDATE INSIGHT.SWEEP_FACILITY SET SWEEP_TYPE = 'I' WHERE SWEEP_NO IN (:sweepNos) AND SWEEP_TYPE = 'W'

INSERT INTO INSIGHT.SWEEP_FACILITY (SWEEP_NO, SWEEP_DATE, SWEEP_TYPE, CLIENT_ID, AMT, REF_ID, SRC_TYPE, SEGMENT_ID, UPD_TIME) VALUES (:sweepNo, :sweepDate, 'P', :accountNumber, :amount, :referenceId, :srcType, 0, SYSDATE)

SELECT CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID, CL_CLIENT_ID, GET_CL_NAME_MAIN_CLIENT(CL_CLIENT_ID) CLIENT_NAME, INSIGHT.F_Get_Balance_As_Of(CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID, CL_CLIENT_ID, SYSDATE, 'N', 'Y') CASH_BALANCE FROM INSIGHT.CB_CLIENT WHERE CL_CLIENT_ID IN (:clientIds) ORDER BY CL_CLIENT_ID

SELECT CLIENT_ID, ISIN, SYMBOL, QUANTITY, CLOSE_PRICE, CURRENCY, MARKET, PRICE_DATE FROM ( SELECT C.CL_CLIENT_ID AS CLIENT_ID, SC.SC_ISIN_CODE AS ISIN, SC.TICKER_ID AS SYMBOL, F.QTY AS QUANTITY, F.PR_C_PRICE AS CLOSE_PRICE, C.CUR_CODE AS CURRENCY, CASE SC.SC_MRK_CODE WHEN 5 THEN 'DFM' WHEN 8 THEN 'DIFX' WHEN 6 THEN 'ADX' END AS MARKET, F.PR_PRICE_DATE AS PRICE_DATE FROM INSIGHT.F_PORT F JOIN INSIGHT.CB_CLIENT C ON F.CLIENT_ID = C.CL_CLIENT_ID JOIN INSIGHT.CB_MAIN_CLIENT M ON C.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID = M.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID JOIN INSIGHT.CB_SEC_COMP SC ON F.COMP_ID = SC.SC_COMP_ID WHERE C.CL_CLIENT_ID IN (:clientIds) AND F.PR_PRICE_DATE = NVL(:asOfDate, TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND F.USR_CODE = 3 AND F.QTY <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT C.CL_CLIENT_ID AS CLIENT_ID, SC.SC_ISIN_CODE AS ISIN, SC.TICKER_ID AS SYMBOL, F.QTY AS QUANTITY, F.PR_C_PRICE AS CLOSE_PRICE, C.CUR_CODE AS CURRENCY, CASE SC.SC_MRK_CODE WHEN 5 THEN 'DFM' WHEN 8 THEN 'DIFX' WHEN 6 THEN 'ADX' END AS MARKET, F.PR_PRICE_DATE AS PRICE_DATE FROM INSIGHT.DERV_F_PORT F JOIN INSIGHT.CB_CLIENT C ON F.CLIENT_ID = C.CL_CLIENT_ID JOIN INSIGHT.CB_MAIN_CLIENT M ON C.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID = M.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID JOIN INSIGHT.CB_SEC_COMP SC ON F.COMP_ID = SC.SC_COMP_ID WHERE C.CL_CLIENT_ID IN (:clientIds) AND F.PR_PRICE_DATE = NVL(:asOfDate, TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1) AND F.USR_CODE = 3 AND F.QTY <> 0 ) PORTFOLIO ORDER BY CLIENT_ID, ISIN
